profile.headline: Senior Team Lead – Mobile Software Engineer at Abbott
profile.jobTitle: Senior Team Lead – Mobile Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Application designer, developer and entrepreneur. Created numerous tools, applications, mobile apps (iOS mostly), plug-ins, scripts and user interfaces for the film, game, 3D animation and medical devices software industries. 
Many years of experience in designing, implementating, maintaining and supporting user-friendly graphical user interfaces for complex tasks. I use a variety of programming languages and frameworks such as Swift, Objective-C, C++, C, Python...  I enjoy applying effective development methods to produce high quality code that delights users, QA and programmers alike.

Specialties: Swift, Objective-C, C++, C, python, java, object oriented programing, Graphical User Interfaces, 3D computer animation, Unix, Linux and OSX software development, html and javascript.
